_help: Room layout used by the 3D view, the localizer, the simulator and train_model.py.
Units are METERS. Origin (0,0) = the room's south-west floor corner, x = east, y = north, z = up.
Pick any wall as 'south' - just be consistent. 20 ft = 6.10 m.
Measure where each board really is (tape measure, +/- 10 cm is fine) and put it here.
Never move a board after recording training data - if you do, record again.
Zones: the floor is cut into cols x rows squares. Columns are letters (A = west), rows are numbers (1 = south).
Edit this file, then restart the server (sudo systemctl restart csi-server).
